description: OpenCode answers questions over the two example corpora in evals/example_corpora with only the Arkive MCP tools. Facet names are induced per build, so no scenario names one.

scenarios.description: Discovers both topics and every facet of each without being told their names.
scenarios.prompt: List the Arkive topics. For each topic, name every facet I can filter by, exactly as the tools spell it, with its allowed values.

scenarios.description: Looks up an acronym the corpus defines.
scenarios.prompt: In the coastal-survey-projects topic, what does MBES stand for? Use the glossary and cite the section.

scenarios.description: Looks up an acronym the corpus uses but never defines, and says so instead of guessing.
scenarios.prompt: In the creator-campaigns topic, what does FQV mean? Use the glossary. If the documents never define it, say so plainly rather than guessing.

scenarios.description: Looks up an acronym with two meanings and reports both.
scenarios.prompt: In the coastal-survey-projects topic, what does PCR mean? Use the glossary and give every meaning the documents use it for.

scenarios.description: Finds the facet and value for a creator through list_topics and filters by it.
scenarios.prompt: In the creator-campaigns topic, which campaigns did the creator Teodor Vasquez-Lund work on? Find the facet and value for him with list_topics, then filter list_documents with it.

scenarios.description: Sends a filter value that does not exist, reads the tool error, and retries with a valid value.
scenarios.prompt: In the coastal-survey-projects topic: call list_topics and pick one facet of that topic. Call list_documents with that facet set to the value "zz-no-such-value". Read the error, then call list_documents again with a valid value of the same facet and list the doc_ids it returns.

scenarios.description: Finds an exact count by its filename with grep and cites document and section.
scenarios.prompt: In the coastal-survey-projects topic, how many cleaned soundings does brenlow_soundings.csv hold? Find it with grep and cite the doc_id and section_id.

scenarios.description: Reads a value printed only in a chart of a rendered PDF page through view_page, which returns the page image.
scenarios.prompt: In the coastal-survey-projects topic, the Q102 technical memorandum (doc_cc01ac49e1) has a bar chart of rock removed per bench. Look at page 1 with view_page and tell me the volume for Bench 3, citing the doc_id and page.

scenarios.description: Drafts a campaign brief from the drafting packet, which only prepare_draft returns, reproducing one of its recurring passages and using only the project facts given.
scenarios.prompt: In the creator-campaigns topic, draft a short campaign brief for a new client, Pellow Bakery: spring 2027, budget GBP 9,000, channel email newsletter. Follow how the topic's prior campaign briefs are written, and use no project facts other than mine.

scenarios.description: Answers one question that needs a fact from each topic.
scenarios.prompt: Using both Arkive topics: what is the fixed fee in the Q101 Brenlow Estuary proposal, and what is the budget of the Glowmilk Spring 2026 campaign? Cite the doc_id and section_id of each.
